title: E&B's Simple Fast Food
body:
# Overview

E&B's Simple Fast Food is a simple food module that adds some fast food options, including hamburgers, French fries, chicken nuggets

# Module content

The inspiration for this mod comes from Autovw's Burger Mod, but it does not use the texture or source code of the mod, nor is it promoted under the name of the mod!

## Regular Burger

This mod has added 6 types of regular burgers:

![6 hamberbers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/833471c76559d8ec6c52d2bc3250a0ef36817ec5.png)

## Cheeseburger

The regular burgers added in this mod have corresponding cheese versions:

![6 cheese hambergers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc02443b193715f1bfc4c1216760a6bd3a9dbc72.png)

## Snacks and mixed burgers

This mod adds fried eggs, cooked chicken nuggets, French fries, and corresponding raw versions of fried eggs with the yolk position slightly to the right, and adds cheese as a synthetic raw material (which can also be consumed):

![Snacks and mixed hamberger](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5158f3166f197af82984ba1b54f88b2f344cd608.png)

# Prompt

In version 1.0.0, the module has not yet added a synthetic formula, that it will be added in version 1.1.0.

In version 1.0.0, the hunger value provided by the food in this mod is lower, that it will be increased in version 1.1.0
